I need to decide whether to mortgage properties or declare bankruptcy to cover the $200 rent owed to player p3.

Mortgaging any of the three available properties will clear the $74 shortfall. I'll choose one to cover the debt.

I'm comparing the three yellow properties to decide which mortgage is best. I'm weighing rent values and future value to determine which one to mortgage now.

Marvin Gardens has the highest base rent at $24, followed by Ventnor Avenue at $22. The difference is small. I'll mortgage one of these properties to cover the shortfall.

Mortgaging Marvin Gardens would leave $66 cash after paying the rent, compared to $56 from the other two. I'll mortgage Marvin to keep the highest rent-generating property unmortgaged.

I reconsidered the mortgage choice. The $10 extra cash from mortgaging Marvin Gardens is too small to justify the $4 higher rent it would generate. I'll mortgage one of the other two yellows instead.
